question: Helicobacter pylori infection is classified as a Group 1 (definite) carcinogen and is the primary cause of gastric adenocarcinoma worldwide.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The IARC classifies H. pylori as a definite (Group 1) carcinogen. It drives chronic gastritis → intestinal metaplasia → dysplasia → adenocarcinoma — the classic Correa cascade.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. H. pylori is an IARC Group 1 carcinogen and is causally linked to approximately 90% of non-cardia gastric adenocarcinomas. Eradication therapy reduces gastric cancer risk.
